listingTitle: Run declared type checking in CI
title: Run declared TypeScript type checking in CI
why: A project that declares a dedicated type-checking script but omits it from direct CI build, test, lint, or check commands can merge code that violates its TypeScript contract.
suggestion: Invoke the declared type-checking script, or a direct equivalent such as tsc --noEmit, in checked-in CI.
limitations: The root package.json and checked-in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure Pipelines, and Jenkins files are inspected.

One level of package-script indirection is resolved, including common npm-run-all wrappers and explicit typecheck/type-check/ts-check task names; arbitrary shell wrappers, reusable workflows, and external CI are not inferred.
The rule abstains unless direct JavaScript build, test, lint, or check commands are present in CI.
